subject: Options for mid-contract capacity add & co-term to 2027-03-31
messages:
From: Emily Smith <emily.smith@sableanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-contract add-on + co-term options

Hi Connor,

Quick note from Sable — we're forecasting a ~2x spike in inference usage for a new feature that launches mid-November. Can you send options for adding committed capacity mid-contract and what co-terming to our renewal (current contract ends 2027-03-31) would look like?

Specific asks:
- Add ~200k tokens/week sustained (estimate attached usage snapshot)
- We prefer co-term to 2027-03-31 if possible (one invoice/more predictable cost)
- What's the pro-rata treatment and any standard uplift discount for adding during the term?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@sableanalytics.com). Would like a proposal this week if possible.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Smith
Head of Platform
Sable Analytics
Attachment: Sable_usage_snapshot_Q3.pdf (pdf, 85KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emily Smith <emily.smith@sableanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract add-on + co-term options

Hi Emily — thanks for the context and the usage snapshot. I've put together three pragmatic paths below; I attached a short spreadsheet with the line-items so your finance team can see the math (connor_sable_uplift_options.xlsx).

1) On-demand add-on (fastest)- We add the extra tokens now, bill monthly at list rate, pro-rated for partial month. No change to renewal date. No discount.

2) Uplift + co-term (recommended for stability)- Convert the add-on to a committed uplift and co-term the entire account to 2027-03-31. We can offer a one-time uplift discount in exchange for the committed throughput (discount applied to the uplifted QPS/tokens bucket).

3) Hybrid (trial + commit)- Short 3-month trial of the add-on at list rate, then convert to committed co-term if you hit a usage threshold; commit pricing would be backdated to conversion date pro-rata.

Questions for your team: preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly), whether procurement needs a PO, and any SOW requirements (if professional services needed to enable the feature).

If you want, I can run this by my pricing manager and come back with a recommended discount band and a formal amendment (SOW/pricing sheet). Does Thursday 9/23 for a quick call work?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: connor_sable_uplift_options.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Sable uplift — ask for discount guidance

Laura, Marissa — following up from the call with Sable. They want to add ~200k tokens/week immediately and prefer to co-term to 2027-03-31. They are sensitive to unit price; their legal/procurement are conservative and prefer predictable monthly costs.

Proposal I want to present: convert to a committed uplift through 2027-03-31, annualize the incremental committed tokens, and offer a discount on the uplifted bucket. My ask: can pricing approve a mid-contract uplift discount in the 8–12% band (vs list) for a 6-month co-term? Economics: the uplift is material but short (co-term to 3/31/27), so 12% might be the high end; if we move to 10% we preserve margin and accelerate conversion to committed revenue.

If you approve, I will send them a formal amendment + a short SOW stating token counts and billing mechanics. Attachment with quick calc.

Attachments: pricing_calc_20260923.xlsx

Thanks,
Connor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Sable uplift — ask for discount guidance

Connor — I think this is a good expansion motion. Approve discount up to 10% for the uplifted committed bucket with the following guardrails:
- Minimum 3-month committed period once converted (even if co-term is shorter, ensure at least 3 months billed)
- Offer one month of usage credit if they convert within 30 days (to reduce trial friction)
- Use exception code RINF-EX10 on the amendment

I'll loop legal for a short amendment template; finance is OK with pro-rata backdating for the commit. Marissa
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emily Smith <emily.smith@sableanalytics.com>, procurement@sableanalytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final proposal: 10% uplift discount + co-term to 2027-03-31

Hi Emily — glad we could align. Based on internal approval, here is the final path we can commit to: 

- Offer: convert the requested add-on (200k tokens/week) into a committed uplift, co-term to 2027-03-31.
- Discount: 10% off list price applied to the uplifted bucket for the co-term period.
- Billing: pro-rated for the month of conversion, billed monthly. We will apply a one-month usage credit if you sign the amendment within 30 days of receipt.
- Guardrails: 3-month minimum billing once the uplift converts.

Next steps: I attached the amendment and SOW (Sable_uplift_statement_of_work_v1.pdf). When you're ready I can route a DocuSign for signatures (link below).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?envelopeId=abc123-docusign

If that looks good I'll send the amendment to procurement and finance.
